name: pybind11
$comment: vcpkg's own pybind11 without its python3: usdcc only uses pybind11::headers, with OpenUSD's Python. vcpkg's python3 forces its own version (3.12 is its newest) on every find_package(Python3) through its CMake wrapper, so an OpenUSD built with another Python isn't found; and on Linux its libpython sits in vcpkg_installed/<triplet>/lib, ahead of the system one on the binaries' RUNPATH, so the app embedded vcpkg's Python instead of OpenUSD's (docs/LINUX_WSL.md).
description: pybind11 is a lightweight header-only library that exposes C++ types in Python and vice versa, mainly to create Python bindings of existing C++ code
